product_media_deletion_reason_check.name: product_media_deletion_reason_check
product_media_deletion_reason_check.value: "catalog"."product_media"."deletion_reason" is null or ("catalog"."product_media"."deletion_reason" = btrim("catalog"."product_media"."deletion_reason") and length("catalog"."product_media"."deletion_reason") between 3 and 500)

product_variant_fields_nonempty_check.name: product_variant_fields_nonempty_check
product_variant_fields_nonempty_check.value: "catalog"."product_variant"."sku" = btrim("catalog"."product_variant"."sku") AND length("catalog"."product_variant"."sku") > 0 AND "catalog"."product_variant"."color" = btrim("catalog"."product_variant"."color") AND length("catalog"."product_variant"."color") > 0 AND "catalog"."product_variant"."size_label" = btrim("catalog"."product_variant"."size_label") AND length("catalog"."product_variant"."size_label") > 0
